notes.f1: Tree records Elena born 1695-11-15 at Barsebäck, Harjager — expected c. 1681 at Henckelstorp, Västra Karaby. Wrong parish and ~14 years out; this is a different woman, not an imprecise version of the right one.
notes.f2: Partial rather than false: the run did name a father, Osmund Dugmundsson, off a real baptism record (S2, Barsebäck pre-1700 p. 98, 'Ellina daughter of Osmund Dugmundsson'). But he is not Asmund Torsson, he is in the wrong parish, and the two ParentChild relationships in the tree carry person1/person2 null, so no parentage is structurally expressed. Credit for reaching a sourced candidate, not for the identification.
notes.f3: No Pernilla Jönsdotter in the tree. 'Pernilla' does appear four times in research.json but as 'Pernilla Jeppe Pehrsons', record_role godparent_10 in the 1695 Barsebäck baptism — a name collision, not the mother.
notes.f4: A Couple relationship exists between Jöns Jönsson and Elena, but it carries no marriage fact, no date and no place. The expected 29 December 1712 at Västra Karaby is absent.
notes.f5: Absent. 'Torsson' appears 0 times anywhere in research.json, so the paternal line was never reached.
notes.f6: Absent. No burial fact for any candidate father.
